advanced-strength-cream.before:
Advanced is the higher-strength Comfort Cream, for regular aesthetic work.

Available in 10g and 30g. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
advanced-strength-cream.removed: Available in 10g and 30g. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.

advanced-strength-gel.before:
Advanced is the higher-strength Comfort Gel — for longer facial sittings and more sensitive precise work. Gel holds where you place it and stays put through a longer sitting.

Available in 15ml and 35ml. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
advanced-strength-gel.removed: Available in 15ml and 35ml. Apply to clean, dry, unbroken skin ahead of time and remove before your appointment; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.

advanced-strength-spray.before:
Advanced is the higher-strength Comfort Spray — for longer or more sensitive body sessions and larger areas. Spray gives even, hands-off coverage, with no layer to work in by hand.

35ml. Hold a short, consistent distance from the skin and cover the area in even passes, on clean, dry, unbroken skin; follow the product guidance and your practitioner. Formulated in the UK, CPSR assessed.
